page_title: Item:Legendary Pendant of the Red Abishai

enchantments.tooltip: Quality Wisdom +3: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Wisdom.
Fire Absorption +36%: Passive: 36% Enhancement Bonus to Fire Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Insightful Combat Mastery +6: +6 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Enhanced Ki +4: Increases the rate at which the user gains ki with each successful attack.
